maddeler.e:
ينبلع (form VII)
# يَنْبَلِعُ (yanbaliʕu) /jan.ba.li.ʕu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْبَلَعَ (inbalaʕa)
# يَنْبَلِعَ (yanbaliʕa) /jan.ba.li.ʕa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْبَلَعَ (inbalaʕa)
# يَنْبَلِعْ (yanbaliʕ) /jan.ba.liʕ/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْبَلَعَ (inbalaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
